sections.html: Neocaridina denticulata Hulk orange is a new dwarf shrimp variety, imported exclusively from Taiwan for the first time. Its main colour is green, with an orange second colour emerging underneath. According to the supplier, the body colour of this shrimp varies according to the environment.

The name comes from the Hulk, a comic character from the Marvel universe, a strong, green fellow with high destructive potential. The shrimp is presumably named so because of its green main colour, although a dwarf shrimp is about as harmless and peaceful as an animal can be.
